item.title: The Good, the Bad and the Cringe: 10 Ads That Defined the Midterms

item.title: From Powerhouse to Punchline: The North Carolina G.O.P. Implosion
item.description: Republicans in North Carolina saw their state as a firewall, gerrymandered to protect incumbents even if Democrats kept winning the governorship. This week, the wall shattered.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Medina
item.media:description: Voters cast their ballots on Tuesday in Fuquay-Varina, N.C.

item.title: He’ll Be Clerk of One of the Country’s Largest Counties. He’s 19.

item.title: Mysterious Request Scrambles Major Supreme Court Gun Case Against Cook County

item.title: Democrats, Newly Ascendant, Begin a Fight to Shape the Party’s Future

item.title: California Still Has Nearly 5 Million Ballots to Count
